targets.name: Small winged finial on the stairpost
targets.concealment: Small bronze wings blend into surrounding railing curls, and the body sits partly behind its raised post.

targets.name: Peacock relief on the umbrella stand
targets.concealment: The gilt bird is worked into matching metal foliage and its long neck follows the stand's curling bars.

targets.name: Sun-faced pendant on the desk drawer
targets.concealment: Gold ring and chain follow the drawer's round pull and carved wood grain, partly meeting its shadow.

targets.name: Small engraved brass jar
targets.concealment: Its narrow gold silhouette sits among similar brass gear rims and engraved metalwork.

targets.name: Loop-ended silver tool
targets.concealment: Thin silver legs align with a row of narrow tool shafts and disappear behind the tray lip.

targets.name: Large brass gear in the tool tray
targets.concealment: The broad gear is partly overlapped by smaller toothed wheels and shares the tray's gold-and-brown pattern.

targets.name: Small round lens among the gears
targets.concealment: A low oval lens is nested among round brass gears and partly meets the tray edge.

targets.name: Frayed workcloth over the desk edge
targets.concealment: Faded tan cloth merges with wood grain and patterned upholstery, folds over itself, and partly disappears beneath the tool tray.

targets.name: Bird stitched on the red cushion
targets.concealment: Gold stitches merge with the cushion's gold leaf embroidery and follow the curved cloth.

targets.name: Sunflower roundel in the railing
targets.concealment: Pointed petals echo nearby gilt scrolls and the circular surround makes it part of the railing pattern.

targets.name: Sealed letter partly beneath the book
targets.concealment: The paper is partly covered by an embossed book and its angled edges follow the tiled tabletop pattern.

targets.name: Two-handled rose cup
targets.concealment: Large pale floral cup is easy to recognize at the front.

targets.name: Brass telescope on the front table
targets.concealment: Distinctive broad telescope lies clearly across the foreground.

targets.name: Lidded brass pot by the cup
targets.concealment: The large lidded gold pot is a clear foreground anchor.

targets.name: Large astronomical sun clock
targets.concealment: The broad sun-faced dial is the room's obvious architectural anchor.

review.notes: Every target inspected against the finished source and regenerated contour context sheets. Names, full visible defining features, occlusion edges and negative-space holes repaired where needed. Difficulty is an authored estimate; physical iPhone/player calibration remains pending.
